svg.title: Genome-wide association
svg.desc: Scatter plot of 895 points: x from 6.7 to 2875.7, y from 0 to 9.31. Groups (points): Odd chromosomes 445, Even chromosomes 450. Lines: p = 5e-8: y = 7.3, 18 points above it. Line for Odd chromosomes through 445 points: y = 0.323 + 0.000 x, r² = 0.011. Line for Even chromosomes through 450 points: y = 0.572 + 0.000 x, r² = 0.001.
